requirements.requirement: Published course-link identities at initial and astro:page-load, independent trees, deduplication, exclude journals/overviews/external/nonmodules, empty groups and reusable badges.

Immutable proof tests and the separate retained nested fixture cover these behaviors. Real browser locale navigation and reload show 22 badges per tree summing to 482; real EventTarget dispatch after browser DOM mutation was not assessed.

At 390px the retained browser receipt records dialog autofocus, Escape close, aria-expanded=false and focus return.

requirements.requirement: RED/GREEN evidence, changed runnable code review, regressions, fullbuild/repeatsync, realbrowser appearance/recomputation/ENFRES/mobile.
requirements.assessment: Retained RED/GREEN evidence, five review lenses, 19 passing final Node tests, the successful 2725-page full build, repeat-sync equality across 1520 files, actual EN/FR/ES browser navigation, sidebar width, reload and mobile dialog checks satisfy the local quality gate. Dynamic changed-link recomputation is evidenced by direct calls to the registered production callback in an in-memory fixture, including 1000 repeated calls. No browser DOM mutation or real EventTarget dispatch was performed; the original testing gaps and subsequent evidence are retained separately.
